status: PROVISIONAL exception record bound to net/anchor/MPN/pose; source geometry only, not routed or measured
rule: An added S2b protection diode is placed within 24 mm (CLUSTER_RADIUS_MM) of its anchor: the amplifiers on its own nets, else the one non-logic IC sharing most of its nets (scripts/checks/partition35_floorplan.py). A diode that cannot be placed inside the radius must be listed here. Each record carries a binding (MPN, nets, anchor refs and MPNs, anchor and diode poses with a tolerance, centre distance) that scripts/checks/partition35_floorplan.py protection_exception_errors() compares with the current placement; a changed placement or a stale record fails. adoption_state PROVISIONAL is not a permanent approval; APPROVED requires a recorded approval.

exceptions.adoption_note: Provisional comparison input for the current 27.61 mm placement. Not a permanent exception and not user approval; see the SEL network review below.
exceptions.anchor: U4206 (TMUX6112PWR); no amplifier shares its nets

search_evidence.method: Instrumented copy of the generator at the committed floorplan (identical output): every 1 mm offset within 24 mm of the anchor, both faces, rotations 0 and 90

exceptions.electrical_impact: Design assumption only, not measured. The earlier wording ('slow select line', 'extra 3.6 mm adds a little capacitance') is withdrawn as unproven: /E2/FALL_CURVE = READY AND FALL AND CURVED changes at envelope stage transitions, and a centre-distance excess is not a trace length. See sel_network_review.
exceptions.proposed_resolution: Phase 36 trial (generator rule nudged_pose: one pinned bypass capacitor may move at most 2.0 mm on its own face without lengthening its supply loop): rejected. Only C4270 (U4245) and C4249 (U4232) are sole blockers of in-radius poses. With either released, the nearest legal pose for C4270 is 20.43 mm away, which lengthens its supply-pad gap from 2.52 mm to 18.11 mm, and C4249 has no legal pose at all. No minimal move exists, so the exception stands.
exceptions.decision: owner decision pending: keep the provisional exception as a comparison input, or approve a multi-part re-placement of the SEL hold networks

sel_network_review.summary: SEL4 hold network: D4232 17.10 mm, D4233 27.61 mm, RB4234 (100 kOhm pull-up) 95.18 mm from U4206; FALL_CURVE driver U4229.3 39.69 mm. 32 of 36 core SEL hold nets have a member beyond 24 mm; no SEL net is routed. A D4233-only permanent exception is not supported by this evidence.
